captions.detailed: This 3D model features a machinist bench vise with a dark blue body and a rotating black swivel base. It includes a sliding jaw that moves prismatically along a light grey rectangular guide bar, and a main screw handle at the front with spherical end knobs for continuous rotation. A small side lock knob with a black tapered collar and grey handle is positioned on the right side of the main housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a machinist bench vise with a swivel base. The assembly should include a fixed body on a rotating base, a sliding front jaw, a rotating front adjustment handle, and a small side lock knob, using blue, black, and light grey materials to distinguish the components.
captions.factory: Construct the model by defining an articulated assembly. Create the swivel base using a flat cylinder and a rectangular clamp block. Build the main vise body using combined box and cylinder primitives, colored dark blue. Model the sliding jaw as a prismatic jointed component using a rectangular guide bar and a blue jaw head with a grey clamping plate. Add a continuous revolute joint for the front handle, constructed from a central cylinder and a crossbar with spherical ends. Finally, add the side lock knob as a small continuous joint on the right side of the main body, using a tapered cylinder and a small perpendicular bar.
